plan.title: bug(release): Windows Step 5 hang detector kills ts:check-lane at 52/1284 files during v0.119.9 cut

narratives.Description: bug(release): Windows Step 5 hang detector kills ts:check-lane at 52/1284 files during v0.119.9 cut
narratives.Overview:
## Summary

Windows production `task release -- 0.119.9` Step 5 failed the 20-minute hang detector (exit 124) on `ts:check-lane` during the v0.119.9 cut attempt on 2026-09-24. No tag was pushed.

## Recurrence signature

- Pipeline: `[5/13] Pre-flight CI ... FAIL (task check timed out after 20m at gate ts:check-lane)`
- Hang cause line: `hang detector timeout (exit 124); last completed test file: packages/core/src/vbrief-validate/extra-coverage.test.ts`
- Progress at kill: `ts:check-lane last-file .../extra-coverage.test.ts (52/1284 files)` — only ~4% of the suite finished inside the 20m wall
- Heavy in-flight / completed files near the kill (wall-clock from check-tee):
  - `session-start-scm-readiness.test.ts` ~54s
  - `dispatcher-owner-liveness.test.ts` ~49s
  - `hook-dispatch-worktree.test.ts` ~42s
  - `vbrief-validate/extra-coverage.test.ts` ~39s
  - `release-input-pipeline.test.ts` ~35s
  - `install-upgrade.test.ts` ~32s
  - also in-flight: `session-start-rearm.test.ts`, `swarm-deep-coverage.test.ts`
- Check-tee: `.deft/check-tees/no-session/43176-7ff8b217.log`
- Host probe at diagnosis (5-sample median): `node -e 0` ~102ms; `git --version` ~252ms (above RELEASING.md stale-binary git ~150ms guidance)

Prior closed hang trackers (#4798, #4801, #4907, #4591 cheapen) do not cover this tip. Do **not** raise `RELEASE_CHECK_TIMEOUT_MS`. Do **not** lead with `--skip-ci` for the v0.119.9 cut.

## Acceptance criteria

1. On this Windows host, `task release` Step 5 `ts:check-lane` (vitest with coverage) completes inside the existing 20-minute hang detector without `--skip-ci` and without raising `RELEASE_CHECK_TIMEOUT_MS`.
2. Cheapening targets measured cost (named heavy files and/or host stale-binary / spawn cost). Success is Step 5 green under the existing timeout, not a higher timeout.
3. CHANGELOG `[Unreleased]` records the cheapen with Tracking/Refs to this issue.
4. After merge, the paused v0.119.9 cut can resume Phase 1 and pass Step 5 without `--skip-ci`.

## Out of scope

- Raising `RELEASE_CHECK_TIMEOUT_MS`
- Equating Ubuntu CI `timeout-minutes: 20` with the Windows release Step 5 kill
- Using `--skip-ci` as the primary remedy for this cut

## Related

- #2859 file-and-merge before resume
- #2652 / #4230 hang recovery docs
- #4591 prior Windows coverage cheapen (439s measured then)
- #4798 / #4801 / #4907 prior hang-bound work (closed)
